g.text: 07 / Reported depth milestones, not a speedup ratio
Synthetic 4096-pattern task · 80% training coverage · 50 randomized runs
Metric: output label information I(Y; output), not percent accuracy.
Paper reports qualitative attainment descriptions, not a common threshold.
Architectures differ. No wall-clock times or matched-compute ratio supplied.
Source: course PDF §3.6 / Figure 5. Milestone cards reproduce prose values.
